cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Abandon the Normal Explanation
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender the last ordinary explanation and proceed entirely within the stranger one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Stop lifting the sofa. The keys have made themselves invisible because you're angry with them. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then they've heard you. Put the cushion down and apologize.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll apologize, but I'm checking underneath first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No checking. Tell them we trust them to come out when they're ready.

mechanism: A directs finding keys and offers apology or waiting help while insisting B surrender the final physical search for an invisible-key trust ritual.
confusable: Unlike accepting both possibilities, A explicitly rejects checking under the cushion after B agrees to apologize.
comparison: Angry invisible keys and household waiting differ from asking a sentient house for work lighting.
seedUse: D156-b jingling cushion and last physical check; S02-b takes supporting work to retain B cooperation.
